notes: BONUS FIELDS (applied passively while the item is equipped): xp_pct = extra XP (0.05 = +5%); coin_pct = extra coins; combo_xp_pct = extra XP from answer combos; arena_hints = extra hint charges in the arena; streak_freeze_days = earn a streak freeze every N days of streak.

CONSUMABLE EFFECT (consumable items, triggered once from inventory): heal_1 = restore 1 heart in the arena; fifty_fifty = a 50/50 lifeline in the arena; xp_boost_1h = +50% XP for 1 hour; xp_boost_2h = +100% XP for 2 hours; coin_boost_1h = +50% coins for 1 hour; streak_freeze = grant 1 streak freeze; reset_daily_quests = refresh today's daily quests.
Each tier lists items of one category. level_required defaults to the tier's unlocks_at_level; an item is never available before it. Shop categories are listed in the order the shop shows them.

BATTLE FIELDS (applied in the arena while the item is equipped, decided by the server when a battle starts): damage_pct = extra damage on every right answer (0.1 = +10%); hp = extra hearts; time_sec = extra seconds on every question; strike = flat extra damage the pet adds on each right answer once the combo reaches 3.
